additions.name: Sakura Ishikari Data Center Existing Operations

status.summary: Dated operator announcement confirms continued operation of the named Ishikari campus since 2011. July 28 is current operating confirmation, not first opening or proof of Building 3 C/D completion.

locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point inside the named Sakura Ishikari parent campus. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, campus boundary, building footprint, or Building 3 C/D fit-out location.
locator.identity_review: The municipal plan labels Sakura Internet Ishikari Data Center on the compound south of Minato-dori and west of the parallel main road. Its perpendicular long buildings, the circular Sun Village sports hall across Minato-dori, the northwest small compound, and the surrounding road geometry match the GSI map. The point is selected within that identified campus only.
locator.uncertainty_reason: Municipal and GSI maps provide no surveyed accuracy for this analyst-selected point; map vintage and manual matching add unquantified uncertainty. Four decimal places are output to avoid implying building or survey precision.

additions.distinctness_review: All 406 baseline sites, 430 projects and 231 source records checked across Sakura, さくら, Ishikari and 石狩 aliases. No Sakura site/project or source-record identity match. The IIJ Shiroi text mention is context only. Nearest existing site is Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 about 232 m northwest, with a different operator/property and BroadBand Tower tenancy. City directory separately lists both facilities. Regional DCC cooperation does not establish shared-campus or lease identity; no contrary primary identity bridge was found.
additions.successor_review: July 27 completed power maintenance independently corroborates live container-facility services. August 3 SOC notice calls Ishikari an operated campus, while its audit period ends May 31; audit receipt is not used as a physical opening or later audit observation. July 28 remains the selected unambiguous whole-campus present-tense confirmation. No dated achieved C/D fit-out observation was established in the July 28 presentation or 2026 integrated report.
